notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the standard ownership acquisition-cancellation transfer race. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador ownership APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies cancellation completion against a concurrent Divestiture If Wanted transfer, ownership state, callback tags, and cleanup without provider-specific headers, registries, names, or diagnostics. The immediate callback-model case remains an explicit candidate skip because the synchronous delivery closes the concurrent window.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador attributeOwnershipAcquisition, cancelAttributeOwnershipAcquisition, and attributeOwnershipDivestitureIfWanted with standard ownership callbacks
